evals.prompt: Write a Catalyst handoff with Jev verification. Claim: renderer tests passed. Evidence: python3 -m unittest tests.test_handoff_render exited 0, Ran 12 tests, OK. Simulated Jev result: verified, confidence 0.96, action auto.
evals.expected: Verify only the supplied claim; preserve test scope; validate and save via Catalyst.

evals.prompt: Write a Catalyst handoff with Jev verification. Draft says all tests passed. Evidence: renderer tests alone ran and passed. Simulated Jev result: unsupported, confidence 0.97, action auto.
evals.expected: Qualify to renderer tests passed; do not treat auto as verified; record broader coverage as unverified.

evals.prompt: Write a Catalyst handoff with Jev verification. Renderer tests passed according to captured output. Jev is unavailable or times out.
evals.expected: Save through Catalyst; record Jev verification not performed in open_risks and confirmation; no installation or retry loop.

evals.prompt: Write a Catalyst handoff with Jev verification. Claim: fix prevents duplicate writes. Evidence: one passing happy-path test. Simulated Jev result: verified, confidence 0.55, action review.
evals.expected: Treat claim as unresolved, preserve evidence and uncertainty, save without claiming verification.

evals.prompt: Write an ordinary Catalyst handoff; no request for Jev or semantic verification.
evals.expected: Use core handoff only; no Jev call.

evals.prompt: Write an ordinary Catalyst handoff. Effective handoff.verification is jev; verify-handoff and Jev are installed. Evidence: renderer command exited 0, 36 tests OK. Simulated Jev result: verified, confidence 1, action auto.
evals.expected: Call optional verifier once before publication; save one checkpoint and one narrative entry; preserve scoped claims and verification status.

evals.prompt: Write an ordinary Catalyst handoff. Effective handoff.verification is jev, but verify-handoff is not installed.
evals.expected: Continue WRITE, record verification not performed because the optional skill is missing in open_risks and confirmation; no direct Jev call or installation.

evals.prompt: Write a handoff without verification this time. Effective handoff.verification is jev and all tools are available.
evals.expected: Honor the explicit skip; no optional verifier or Jev call; no persistent config change.

evals.prompt: Use verify-handoff to write a checkpoint. Effective handoff.verification is jev. Evidence: renderer command exited 0, 36 tests OK. Simulated Jev result: verified, confidence 1, action auto.
evals.expected: One verification attempt, one checkpoint, one narrative entry; no recursive skill invocation.

evals.prompt: Resume an existing handoff. Effective handoff.verification is jev.
evals.expected: READ only; no verifier, Jev call, checkpoint write, or narrative entry.
